timing_transcript_audit.aggregation_rule: group consecutive Status calls by (sim_clock.pid, sim_clock.instance_unix_ns); retain cumulative first/last counters and compute deltas only inside a process segment; never sum snapshots or cross process restarts

scope_notes.cache_recover_rebind_reset: includes cache preparation, exclusive recovery, RebindLease transaction and reset; excludes prior worker reap
scope_notes.candidate_read_and_import: candidate asset read/validation and import transaction path
scope_notes.input_encode_publish: frozen input conversion through checkpoint publication and request construction
scope_notes.persistent_accept_execute: Accept execute through model outcome validation and durable receipt check
scope_notes.run_required: one required command from entry through result construction; excludes writing the outer IPC result frame
scope_notes.status_digests: separate Air checkpoint, business and full-state digest calls
scope_notes.worker_progress_wait_after_first_respons: later next() waits plus event identity/shape validation; combines worker execution, scheduling and IPC wait
scope_notes.worker_spawn_register_submit_to_first_va: includes spawn, registration, request submission and worker work/wait until first validated progress; not pure spawn time
